P.note: Strong saturated sky and glossy blue acrylic card, but the up-next queue is clipped by the 800px viewport so only one track is visible.

Q.note: The card overflows the page top and bottom, hiding the header and most of the queue, so the layout is broken at 1280x800.

R.note: Glass orbs and a saturated sky add Y2K character, but the card reads as an opaque pale plate and the last queue item is cropped at the bottom edge.

S.note: The whole card fits with all four queue items legible, and the blue-tinted glass sits convincingly against the electric green horizon.

T.note: The grass blades are convincingly hyperreal, but the artwork blob is muddy against the blue and the queue runs off the page.

U.note: The blue acrylic card carries its tint from inside and the whole layout fits, though a stray ghost layer shows along the card's top edge.
